programmes.t: Strongman Champions League: SCL Lithuania World Log Lift Championships
programmes.d: Taking place in Kaunas, Lithuania’s second largest city, the third Strongman Champions League 2017 competition is a special in the tournament. In the country of four-time Strongman World Champion and Log Lift record holder Zydrunas Savickas.
SCL Holland, taking place in Lichtenvoorde, sees 14 athletes competing in six spectacular disciplines. The event welcomes back the title defender and winner of SCL Holland 2016, Eric Dawson (USA).
